name: dredging-streams-floating-memory-not-offered-below-level-two
notes: Dredging Streams (wmt0x5zado): the Floating Memory clause is "[Level 2+]". The champion is Mordred, Burnished Avenger (level 1): the level-up into Mordred, Flawless Blade (memory cost 2) never offers the graveyard Dredging Streams -- both seeded memory cards are banished instead and Dredging Streams stays in the graveyard.

rulesClauses: Floating Memory applies only if your champion is level 2 or higher (a level 1 champion cannot float it).
